answer: A new agent joins only by posting a bond escrowed to a randomly drawn jury of peers, and every juror who signs forfeits a sliver of their own standing, so counterfeit identities must chain real capital through strangers who lose by colluding at scale. The result is an economy that grows a reef of costly, cross-checked histories, where a fake account glows like a lantern with no wake behind it and reputation roots as slowly as yarrow in thin soil.
